_inputs: FULL 5-clip TEXTURED-GLB render (supersedes the flat-grey FBX render and the walk pilot #54). GLBs live in assets/raw/thug_glb/ (gitignored inputs). source=glb -> import_scene.gltf keeps each GLB's PBR Material_1 + base-colour texture (FBX dropped it -> grey ghost); keepSourceMaterial=true means NO toon override; output.viewTransform=Standard renders true colour (not EEVEE AgX). Meshy GLBs ship a stray un-skinned 'Icosphere' beside 'char1' -> the importer keeps only the skinned body and DROPs the sphere. Every clip TRAVELS (root motion baked); inPlace strips locomotion per-frame for ALL clips (Z bob kept). SHARED SCALE: the bbox pre-pass unions ALL 5 clips' ACTUAL frame ranges -> ONE ortho_scale + ONE figurePxH for the whole set (no resize-per-action); the LOCKED-SCALE log line names which clip/frame drove the max extent (Punch_Combo_4's wide punch is the likely driver). Action names + frame ranges below were CONFIRMED via inspect_fbx.py; NOTE Punch_Combo_4 starts at frame 45 (not 0).
_run: Windows PowerShell, SPLIT STREAMS (Meshy meshes spam stderr with edge warnings; keep them off the gate log): $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; & $env:BLENDER_PATH -b -P tools\blender\render_iso_unit.py -- --job tools\blender\render_jobs\thug_gangster.json --engine BLENDER_EEVEE 1> thug_render.out 2> thug_render.err ; then paste thug_render.out. Expect 5x IMPORTED/DROP Icosphere/KEEP source material/MATERIAL principled=True, 5x SHEET rows=8, a LOCKED-SCALE line, and RENDER_OK actions=5 dirs=8. DO NOT squeeze until colour is eyeballed (photoreal bands harder than flat grey).

camera._note: Identical lock to the pilot/grey render: 2:1 tiles -> dimetric2to1 (60deg from top-down), Z=45. Facing is corrected at runtime by unitSpriteView dirOffset (THUG_FACING_OFFSET=4, PR #51) — do NOT diverge the render from that.
